events.label: birth
events.text: Born in Luxembourg, of French Huguenot ancestry.

evidence.quote: ( 2 October 1852 – 28 December 1931 )
François was born in Luxembourg of French Huguenot ancestry

events.label: war
events.text: Served as a soldier in the Franco-Prussian War.

evidence.quote: He served as a soldier in the Franco-Prussian War of 1870–71

events.label: expedition
events.text: Worked as geographer on an exploratory expedition along the Kasai River.

evidence.quote: In 1883 he worked as a geographer on an exploratory expedition along the Kasai River

events.label: expedition
events.text: Joined another Congo expedition led by George Grenfell.

evidence.quote: and two years later joined another expedition into the Congo led by George Grenfell

events.text: Stationed as a research officer in German West Africa.

evidence.quote: In 1887 he was stationed as a research officer in German West Africa

events.text: German Colonial Society engaged him to provide security to the territory.

evidence.quote: the German Colonial Society engaged Hauptmann Curt von François to provide security to the territory

events.text: Published 'Reise im Hinterlandes des deutschen Schutzgebiets Togo'.

evidence.quote: Berlin 1888 - Travel in the Hinterland of the German Togo Conservation Area

events.text: Published 'Die Erforschung des Tschuapa und Lulongo'.

evidence.quote: Brockhaus , Leipzig 1888 . - Exploration of Tschuapa and Lulongo

events.text: Arrived with 21 troopers in British-held Walvis Bay.

evidence.quote: In June 1889 he arrived with 21 troopers

events.text: Stationed himself at Otjimbingwe against the advice of Heinrich Göring.

evidence.quote: Soon afterwards François stationed himself at Otjimbingwe

events.text: Original Schutztruppe headquarters at Windhoek built at his behest.

evidence.quote: The original Schutztruppe headquarters built at the behest of François in 1890

events.label: treaty
events.text: Renewed a former peace agreement with Herero chief Maharero.

evidence.quote: In May 1890 he renewed a former peace agreement with the Herero chief Maharero

events.text: Responsible for the foundation of the city of Windhoek.

evidence.quote: the foundation of the city of Windhoek on 18 October 1890

events.text: Began service as Reichskommissar of German South West Africa.

evidence.quote: François served as Reichskommissar of German South West Africa from March 1891 until November 1893

events.text: Harbor of Swakopmund completed (date conflicts with later source).

evidence.quote: the harbor of Swakopmund on 4 August 1892

events.text: Established the coastal town of Swakopmund as the main harbour.

evidence.quote: ( on 12 September 1892 ) he established the coastal town of Swakopmund as the main harbour

events.label: battle
events.text: Led attack on Hendrik Witbooi's headquarters at Hoornkrans, later called a massacre.

evidence.quote: On 12 April 1893 he led an attack of 225 German soldiers

events.text: Ended service as Reichskommissar of German South West Africa.

evidence.quote: François served as Reichskommissar of German South West Africa from March 1891 until November 1893

events.text: Promoted to Major.

evidence.quote: In November 1893 he was promoted to Major and given the title of Landeshauptmann

events.text: Given the title of Landeshauptmann of South West Africa.

evidence.quote: In November 1893 he was promoted to Major and given the title of Landeshauptmann

events.text: Replaced as Landeshauptmann by Theodor Leutwein.

evidence.quote: In 1894 François was replaced by Theodor Leutwein as Landeshauptmann

events.text: Embarked in Cape Town for Germany.

evidence.quote: He embarked in Cape Town to Germany

events.text: Retired from military life.

evidence.quote: during the following year he retired from military life

events.text: His force formally established as the Imperial Schutztruppe by Reich Law.

evidence.quote: François force was formally established as the Imperial Schutztruppe for German South West Africa by the Reich Law of 9 June 1895

events.text: Published 'Deutsch-Südwest-Afrika' (German South West Africa).

evidence.quote: Verlag D . Reimer , Berlin 1899 . - German South West Africa

events.text: Published 'Kriegführung in Süd-Afrika' (Warfare in South Africa).

evidence.quote: Dietrich Reimer , Berlin 1900 . - Warfare in South Africa

events.text: Published 'Lehren aus dem Südafrikanischen Kriege' (Lessons from the South African War).

evidence.quote: Verlag E . S . Mittler & Sohn , Berlin 1901

events.text: Published 'Der Hottentotten-Aufstand' (The Hottentot uprising).

evidence.quote: Berlin 1905 . - The Hottentot uprising

events.label: death
events.text: Died in a Königs Wusterhausen hospital.

evidence.quote: He died in a Königs Wusterhausen hospital on 28 December 1931

Became a member of the German General Staff (no date)
Explored Togoland and the trade route to Salaga for the Foreign Office (no date)

Occupied the destroyed settlement of Windhoek, after May 1890 (no date)
Mapped large parts of the colony (no date)
